frame.note: Same frame as map/research-techno-plaza.json: x = metres east, y = metres north of geo_origin (SW corner of the building outline's bounding box). All levels share one canvas.
frame.svg: 1 SVG user unit = 1 metre; svg_x = x, svg_y = -y (north is up on the page).
frame.png: px = origin_px[0] + x * pixels_per_metre; py = origin_px[1] - y * pixels_per_metre

notes: Also tinted: 21 key-card room(s) outside those labs (preview3d/places.json), each entered at its own door.

MazeMap draws this level as loose rooms only. Its corridors, lifts and stairs are level 5's, cut back where level 6's rooms stand; rooms are copied only where floors 3-5 agree; area 2 is set back to its roof's outline; the undivided space in area 1 is CINTRA's restricted area (team notes; map/derive_level6.py writes these into map/site-corrections.json). Blue: the glass sides of the link from area 1 to area 2. Hatched: the roof of level 5.
